algorithm: Trim outer whitespace; empty is MALFORMED_VERSION_RANGE.

Parse entire expression before testing actual. Exact versions and wildcards stand alone. Bounds are one or two whitespace-separated tokens with no whitespace between operator and version. Two bounds must contain one lower and one upper, in either order.

Major.minor is historical shorthand for major.minor.0. All numeric components are nonnegative decimal integers without leading zeros, <= maximumComponent. Build metadata and prerelease are unsupported.
Wildcards are half-open intervals: M.x/M.* => [M.0.0,(M+1).0.0); M.m.x/M.m.* => [M.m.0,M.(m+1).0).
Bounds retain their inclusive/exclusive flags. Lower > upper, or equal with either exclusive, is INVALID_VERSION_RANGE. Duplicate directions and other syntax are MALFORMED_VERSION_RANGE.
Parse actual with versionPattern or return MALFORMED_VERSION. Compare integer tuples lexicographically. Outside interval is INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION_RANGE; inside is OK.
